svg.title: MZ-AHP-OS-002 Circular Menstrual Pad — Layer Stack
svg.desc: Conceptual layer stack for an open-source menstrual pad reference model. Not to scale and not production validated.
svg.text: MZ-AHP-OS-002 · Circular Menstrual Pad · Conceptual Layer Stack
NOT TO SCALE · DESIGN REFERENCE · MATERIALS NOT YET QUALIFIED
skin / body side
1 · Topsheet — candidate hydrophilic PP or validated fibre topsheet
skin contact
2 · ADL — candidate cellulose-based or polyolefin layer
3 · upper core wrap — tissue or declared nonwoven
4 · Absorbent core
cellulose fluff/pulp + optional SAP, recorded separately
5 · lower core wrap — tissue or declared nonwoven
6 · Barrier backsheet — candidate PE/polyolefin structure
7 · garment adhesive — minimized and chemistry declared
garment side
system components, quantified separately:
• optional wings
• release liner
• individual wrapper
• outer packaging
Circular-design intent: keep wrapper/liner/packaging visible in the BOM, simplify material families where performance allows, and validate treatment compatibility before any recovery claim.
Evidence boundary: this SVG describes architecture only; it is not proof of safety, comfort, absorbency, leakage protection, recyclability or environmental benefit.
